title: A Song of Storms
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|This is a page about the Shrine Quest in {{BotW}}. For the song from {{OoT}}, see [[Song of Storms]].}} {{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW A Song of Storms.png |caption= |type= Shrine |game= BotW |giver= [[Kass]] |location= Calora Lake |prereq= |reward= [[Qukah Nata Shrine]] |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|A Song of Storms||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Shrine Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|A Song of Storms}}
{{Color BotW|Shrine Quest|Calora Lake}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== At [[Calora Lake]] in [[West Necluda]], [[Link]] can find [[Kass]] singing about [[Lightning]].{{Cite|Lightning from the sky...|Kass|BotW}} He is impressed that Link was able to make it up so high in spite of the [[Thunderstorm]],{{Cite|Very impressive. Not many could make it up here in such rain.|Kass|BotW}} though he recognizes that such a feat is feasible for a traveler like Link.{{Cite|I'd expect no less from a well-worn traveler like yourself.|Kass|BotW}} Even though it is [[Rain]]ing, Kass's feathers are able to repel the wetness, and his bandonean is designed to withstand moisture.{{Cite|Me? I stay nice and dry. My feathers repel the rain rather well. And my instrument was designed to withstand extreme moisture.|Kass|BotW}} His livelihood collecting "[[Ancient Song]]s" has prepared him for such a scenario.{{Cite|When your livelihood revolves around ancient songs, you've got to be prepared for a few raindrops.|Kass|BotW}} On that topic, Kass reveals that he knows an "Ancient Song" pertaining to the area,{{Cite|I know a song about this place.|Kass|BotW}} and he asks Link if he would like to hear it.{{Cite|Would you like to hear the ancient verse passed down in this region?|Kass|BotW}} When Link agrees, Kass then sings it for him.{{Cite|[Let's hear it.] Excellent! Without further ado...|Kass|BotW}} The song details a lost hero calling Lightning from the sky, at which point a [[Monk]] will respond from a [[Giant Mound]].{{Cite|When a lost hero calls down {{Color BotW|Red|lightning}} from the sky / The monk responds from a {{Color BotW|Red|giant mound}} on high.|Kass|BotW}} Though Kass realizes that there is a puzzle within the lyrics, he thinks it could apply to many things.{{Cite|There's a puzzle in this somewhere, but as far as I can tell, it could apply to a great many things.|Kass|BotW}} He bids Link farewell,{{Cite|Anyway, may the light shine ever on your path.|Kass|BotW}} which initiates the [[Shrine Quest]]. To access the [[Ancient Shrine]], Link must attract the Thunderstorm's Lightning to the Giant Mound with a metal [[Weapon]]. When it is struck, the Mound will shatter, revealing [[Qukah Nata Shrine]].{{Cite|By attracting a lightning strike, you shattered the large rock and revealed an ancient shrine concealed within.|Adventure Log|BotW}} Once Link activates the Shrine, the Shrine Quest is completed. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | "When a lost hero calls down lightning from the sky / The monk responds from a giant mound on high."

Solve the riddle of the song you learned from Kass and seek out the hero's trial. |- | 2 | "When a lost hero calls down lightning from the sky / The monk responds from a giant mound on high."

By attracting a lightning strike, you shattered the large rock and revealed an ancient shrine concealed within. |- | Complete | "When a lost hero calls down lightning from the sky / The monk responds from a giant mound on high."

You found an ancient shrine inside the rock that you shattered with lightning! }} ==Trivia== * This Shrine Quest is hinted at in ''[[Kass's Journal]]'', which can be found in a hut on [[Washa's Bluff]].{{Cite|"The ancient song of {{Color BotW|Blue|Calora Lake}}."|Kass's Journal|BotW}} In it, Kass writes that has heard of the "Ancient Song" about the Giant Mound at Calora Lake, but since the area is prone to Thunderstorms, he needs to prepare before he investigates.{{Cite|Apparently there is an ancient song about the giant boulder in {{Color BotW|Blue|Calora Lake}} in the Faron Region. I hear that area is prone to violent thunderstorms. I'll need to prepare before I go searching for the song.|Kass's Journal|BotW}} * The name of this Shrine Quest is a reference to the "[[Song of Storms]]," a song from {{OoT}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW Qukah Nata Shrine.png|Qukah Nata Shrine ==See Also== {{See Also| * Calora Lake * Kass * Qukah Nata Shrine }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |shrine-quests= BotW }}
